description: 187 plain-language consumer job searches. `intended` is the occupation a person means, resolved exact-title-first: banding on any substring match wrongly counted 'carpenter' as publicly answerable because 'Cabinetmakers and Bench Carpenters' contains 'Carpenters'. `band` follows the intended occupation's authoritative publication status, so a query for an unpublished occupation is graded on whether search says so honestly. Where the curated alias catalogue maps a term to a published occupation, the expected answer is that published mapping: the catalogue is the editorial record of which interpretations are acceptable. Queries whose exact-title match is an ', All Other' residual bucket are banded to the published specific sibling instead — nobody searches for a residual category.
